spec.purpose: The ONE shared browser API contract for the beta. It maps every live frontend call onto routes that already exist in the backend, or marks the call client-owned. The base v1.2.0 surface invents no server resource and adds no route; the AGREED additive v1.2.1 block adds exactly one retrieval route (GET /v1/assignments/{assignment_id}/jobs, FCM 2b4720bc item 3), recorded in server_routes with its additive_v1_2_1 marker.
spec.why_minimum: The frontend's parallel model (assignments, uploads, drafts, finalize, submissions, queue) is a full server domain that would need its own schema, authorization, migration and review. The beta needs marking to work end-to-end: upload a private PDF, create and run a job, read the projection, record decisions. Everything else is local UI state until that loop is proven live.
spec.agreement_rule: status may only become AGREED together with confirmed_by set to the teammate message id that confirmed this exact version. The test suite refuses AGREED without a confirmation reference.

api/app.py route table at this backend commit

principles: Errors use the existing backend vocabulary; the frontend maps codes, it does not invent response shapes.
The client never chooses a job id, result id, owner or tenant.
A retry is the same job: no new idempotency key and no new document digest.
Server-owned state is limited to documents, jobs, results, decisions and events. Assignment/draft/queue UI state stays on the device.
No wildcard CORS, no browser-visible bucket URL, no signed URL in the beta slice.
No deployment, migration, cloud activation or paid engine call is part of this contract.

The client never chooses an assignment id either: it sends an idempotency key and the server mints assignment_id. Replaying the key returns the same assignment; reusing it for a different title is a 409.

server_routes.purpose: Private PDF upload. Raw bytes in the body, ?filename= for the display name. Validates signature/size/pages/encryption, computes sha256 server-side, stores owner+tenant scoped. 201 stored, 200 identical replay. Returns document_digest.
Owner+tenant scoped private read. Unknown/foreign/malformed digest is the same 404.
Create or replay one durable marking job. Body {idempotency_key, document_digest}. The document must already belong to this owner+tenant.
server_routes.additive_v1_2_1: optional assignment_id is AGREED as additive v1.2.1 (migration 0008): shape-checked asg_[0-9a-f]{24}, ownership validated under the verified tenant+owner, 400 malformed / 404 assignment_not_found indistinguishable from absent / 409 idempotency_key_payload_mismatch on replay with a different link; job payloads carry assignment_id ONLY when linked (absent-means-omit, a null is never emitted - corrected from FCM's draft 'echo assignment_id|null' to match shipped commit 0668bf57)

server_routes.purpose: Job state: job_id, status, attempts, max_attempts, document_digest, result_id, error_code; a succeeded job also carries marks-only questions.
Retry/execute the same job. This is the ONLY control action in beta.
Register a reviewed result. Not on the current frontend path; kept for the reconciled submission flow.
Marks-safe view: result_id, result_revision, questions, totals. The read model for a submission.
Approve/correct/flag one question with optimistic revision + idempotency key.
Append-only decision stream for one result.

Create or replay one server-owned teacher assignment. Header Idempotency-Key (canonical; body idempotency_key accepted only as an equal alias) + body {title}. tenant/owner come only from the verified token; assignment_id is minted server-side (asg_ + 24 hex). 201 {assignment_id,title,created_at}; 200 same body on same-key/same-title replay; 409 idempotency_key_payload_mismatch on same key with a different title; 400 payload_invalid for a blank/over-200 title, a missing or malformed key, or header/body keys that differ.

Newest-first page of THIS owner's assignments (owner_subject, mirroring documents ownership; a tenant-wide teacher view would be an additive later version). ?limit=1..100 (default 50) and an opaque ?cursor= from the previous page. 200 {assignments:[{assignment_id,title,created_at}], next_cursor: string|null}; 400 payload_invalid for a malformed cursor.

server_routes.additive_v1_2_1: AGREED v1.2.1 (FCM 2b4720bc-94e0-4b8a-93e1-086cb0784ae7 item 3; CM AGREED in reply): server-side assignment-scoped job retrieval - the recovery primitive that replaces a device-local assignment->job_id mapping as the only path. Implemented at backend_commit 313251b720da70e1f09f27faf10cb708a4670423.
server_routes.purpose: Newest-first page of THIS owner's jobs linked to one assignment. 200 {jobs:[<job payload objects exactly as GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} returns them, assignment_id present>], next_cursor: string|null}; ?limit=1..100 (default 50, bounds identical to GET /v1/assignments) and an opaque ?cursor=. Order created_at DESC, job_id DESC (keyset; no OFFSET; no duplicates or skips across pages). 400 payload_invalid for a malformed assignment_id or cursor; 404 assignment_not_found for an absent or other-owner assignment, indistinguishable from absent, never 403.

frontend_calls.justification: v1.2: the assignment row is now server-owned so it survives a reload and a second device. The client sends title + idempotency key only; the server mints assignment_id and derives tenant/owner from the verified token.
Collapsed into one authenticated upload of the raw PDF. fileId is the returned document_digest. This needs no signed URL, no bucket credential in the browser and no new storage adapter.
The upload validates and stores atomically, so there is nothing to confirm. A local no-op may keep the UI state machine intact; it must not be HTTP.

The current ApiClient has NO job-creation call - confirmUpload was expected to start marking. After the upload returns document_digest the client must call POST /v1/jobs once per (assignment, student, document). No backend route is added.
retry maps to /run. cancel/pause/resume have no backend route in beta and must not be rendered as live actions.
A server-side queue needs the assignment resource. The client keeps its job ids per assignment and polls GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}, or renders last-known state.
Drafts are device state keyed by Google sub + assignment + student ref. Storing them server-side would need new authorization semantics and is not in beta scope.
Finalisation is the set of per-question decisions. There is no server finalize verb in beta; the score is computed from the decision responses and the projection.
submissionId is the result_id the job returns. The projection supplies questions and totals; no student answer text is served.
1:1. The client must send question_number as a string; the backend now also accepts an integer and normalises it, so the integer form is no longer a 422.

durable_worker_trigger.row_5_unchanged: v1.1 changes no row: browser retry still drives the synchronous, lease-guarded POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/run. A second call while the lease is live is refused.
durable_worker_trigger.executor: A queued job is executed by the durable worker (worker.py, one job per Cloud Run Jobs invocation) when triggered by the operator or a scheduler: Cloud Scheduler -> gcloud run jobs execute marker-worker. The trigger is operator infrastructure; it is not a client responsibility and not a server route.
durable_worker_trigger.client_recovery: The client's recovery path is always polling GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} with backoff 1s, 2s, 4s, then 5s, stopping at approximately 2 minutes and rendering the last-known state. A client timeout abandons the wait, never the job.
durable_worker_trigger.rejected_alternatives: Self-trigger from the API (a) and no operational trigger (b) are not part of this contract; FCM explicitly refused both.

identity.token: Google ID token in Authorization: Bearer; verified server-side against GOOGLE_OIDC_AUDIENCE.
identity.tenant_and_owner: Derived only from verified subject + active membership. Never accepted from the client.
identity.question_number_normalisation: stripped string; booleans, empty and >256 characters are refused
identity.submission_identity: submissionId == result_id returned by the job
identity.assignment_identity: assignment_id is minted by the server (asg_ + 24 lowercase hex) and is echoed to the client; the client never supplies it. tenant_id and owner_subject are derived from the verified token only.

idempotency.job_key_rule: job-<first 32 hex chars of sha256(assignmentId + '|' + studentRef + '|' + document_digest)>
idempotency.regenerate_only_when: the key is stable per (assignment, student, document) intent; it changes when any tuple member changes (assignmentId, studentRef or document_digest); a retry reuses the same key and POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/run needs no new key
idempotency.retry_rule: a retry is POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/run with no new key
idempotency.decision_key_rule: client-generated per (result_id, question_number, intended payload); replaying the same key with a different payload is refused with idempotency_key_payload_mismatch
idempotency.assignment_key_rule: client-generated per intended (title) payload; same key + same title returns the SAME assignment (200), same key + different title is refused with idempotency_key_payload_mismatch (409)
idempotency.assignment_lookup_rule: the key is scoped to (tenant_id, owner_subject), so two teachers using the same literal key get different assignments

auth.rule: 403 tenant_membership_required is a membership problem, NOT an expired session. The client must not sign the user out or treat it as a retryable auth error.

error_contract.conflict_recovery: On stale_revision refetch GET /v1/results/{result_id}/projection, take result_revision, and re-apply the teacher's unchanged decision. review_question_ambiguous and review_question_unavailable also mean 'refetch the projection', never 'retry the same body'. Everything else is shown to the teacher; nothing is retried blindly.
error_contract.validation: 400 payload_invalid (server cap 32 KiB for non-upload writes); 413 payload_invalid / document_too_large for uploads.

runtime_codes.note: Startup-log problem codes and job error_code values, NOT HTTP error-envelope codes. A process that cannot compose itself fails the revision; an unconfigured request path still answers with authentication_required (401, detail oidc_not_configured) or store_unusable / dev_opt_in_required / model_unavailable (503).

cors.note: The production and any preview origin must be named explicitly. There is no wildcard fallback and an invalid allowlist fails startup.

client_owned_state.assignment: server-owned since v1.2 (POST/GET /v1/assignments); drafts stay device-local and are keyed by the server assignment_id
client_owned_state.drafts: device storage keyed by Google sub + assignmentId + studentRef; never uploaded; never rendered for a different sub
client_owned_state.queue: local list of job ids per assignment, refreshed through GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}
client_owned_state.logout: stop rendering the previous sub's drafts; the bytes stay on the device under that sub key until the user discards them

headers.Idempotency-Key: required (canonical carrier): string 8..128 chars, no '/', no control chars

body.title: required, string, trimmed, 1..200 chars after trimming
body.idempotency_key: optional alias; if present it MUST equal Idempotency-Key, otherwise 400 payload_invalid

response_replay.body: identical to the created body for the same key + title

errors.400: payload_invalid (blank/over-long title, missing/malformed key, header/body key mismatch, malformed cursor)

query.cursor: opaque string from next_cursor; malformed => 400 payload_invalid

response.next_cursor: opaque string or null when the page is not full

list.order: created_at DESC, assignment_id DESC (keyset; no OFFSET, no duplicates across pages)
list.scope: owner_subject only (the caller's own rows within their tenant)

out_of_scope_v1_2: renaming or deleting an assignment (no UPDATE/DELETE grant, no route)

job-to-assignment linkage: OUT of the v1.2.0 wire surface itself, but AGREED as the additive v1.2.1 block (see additive_after_v1_2) - never silently folded into v1.2.0; the agreed v1.2.0 client never sends assignment_id and an unlinked job payload stays byte-identical

document-to-assignment linkage: POST /v1/documents does not accept assignment_id and no document-registration route exists to carry one; it MUST be agreed no later than v1.3 (which request carries it, and against which document identity) and may not slip silently past it
assignments.server_owned: schema/postgres_v7_assignments.sql (DRAFT, not applied): PK (tenant_id,owner_subject,assignment_id), UNIQUE (tenant_id,owner_subject,idempotency_key), RLS tenant_isolation, SELECT+INSERT only for marker_app

projection_question_fields.semantics: Optional carry-through on each projection question. Present when the backend has stored a value, absent otherwise; the frontend renders nothing when a field is absent (no fabrication, no client default presented as review evidence).
projection_question_fields.boundary: Richer scheme evidence - per-question mark-scheme lines, A/M/B scheme annotations, or any engine-output field beyond these four - is OUT of v1.2. It needs a separate owner-approved scope with its own contract version; it is neither invented here nor silently deferred as done.
projection_question_fields.status: AGREED as part of v1.2.0 (FCM a6c33dfa-7938-424f-9ec1-a35a53a02d2b); the richer-scheme-evidence boundary stays OUT

request.assignment_id: optional asg_<24 lowercase hex>; omit or null = unlinked

response.assignment_id: present ONLY on a linked job (absent-means-omit; a null is never emitted), so an unlinked job's payload is byte-identical to the agreed v1.2.0 shape

errors.400: payload_invalid (present but blank, wrong shape, or >64 chars)
errors.404: assignment_not_found (not an assignment of this tenant+owner; never 403)
errors.409: idempotency_key_payload_mismatch (replay with a DIFFERENT assignment_id or document_digest)

wire.database: composite FK (tenant_id, owner_subject, assignment_id) -> assignments; cross-owner linkage refused even if the API check regresses

retrieval_route.query: limit=1..100 (default 50, bounds identical to GET /v1/assignments) and an opaque cursor taken from the previous next_cursor
retrieval_route.response: 200 {jobs: [<job payload objects exactly as GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} returns them, assignment_id present>], next_cursor: string|null}
retrieval_route.order: created_at DESC, job_id DESC (keyset; no OFFSET; no duplicates or skips across pages)
retrieval_route.errors: 400 payload_invalid for a malformed assignment_id or cursor; 404 assignment_not_found for an absent or other-owner assignment, indistinguishable from absent, never 403

association_boundaries.job_to_document: exactly 1 via document_digest (already in the agreed v1.2.0 job body)
association_boundaries.document_to_assignment: NOT linked in v1.2.1 - no route exists to carry it; MUST be defined by v1.3
association_boundaries.assignment_job_enumeration: SERVED in v1.2.1: GET /v1/assignments/{assignment_id}/jobs (FCM 2b4720bc item 3; implemented at 313251b720da70e1f09f27faf10cb708a4670423) is the server-side source of truth for an assignment's jobs; a client-side assignment->job_id map may exist only as a cache, never as the only recovery path (this replaces the earlier deferral text, which listed this route as a v1.3 decision)
association_boundaries.identity: assignment_id is server-minted (asg_ + 24 lowercase hex), immutable, never client-supplied as identity; tenant and owner come only from the verified bearer token
association_boundaries.ownership_validation: API layer: shape check, then lookup under verified tenant+owner, 404 assignment_not_found indistinguishable from absent (never 403); database layer: composite FK (tenant_id, owner_subject, assignment_id) makes cross-owner linkage physically unrepresentable
association_boundaries.idempotency_retry: one stable job idempotency key per create intent; replay with the same (document_digest, assignment_id) pair replays the stored job; replay with a different pair is 409 idempotency_key_payload_mismatch; POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/run retries the SAME job and never regenerates the key
